causal_change.factor: Construction locus at which the sole strength-bearing mechanism first becomes executable
causal_change.before: A complete engine is the first executable construction substrate: the champion emits a representation-only whole engine and implements the strength mechanism only inside the final whole-engine transduction, while R17 transmits non-executable edit instructions and likewise defers strength-bearing execution to the final engine.
causal_change.after: Before any candidate engine or source edit exists, one mechanism foundry implements and executes exactly one strength-bearing capability as a bounded standalone non-UCI component with an explicit interface; one final grafting call embeds that same demonstrated component behavior into the untouched supplied anchor and emits the sole engine.
causal_change.why_causal: The first execution substrate determines which failures can be observed before engine coupling obscures them. Making the mechanism itself runnable exposes its state assumptions, determinism, edge behavior, and bounded work cost while they are still locally repairable; whole-engine integration then becomes an interface-grafting problem rather than the first implementation of an abstract diagnosis. The two asymmetric calls, analysis output, and untouched-anchor handoff are necessary consequences of changing this locus, not additional experimental factors.

hypothesis.expected_effect: The final producer should receive a realized capability and execution evidence instead of a normalized engine, private rationale, probe alone, or declarative edit program. It can spend its construction effort preserving the anchor while resolving actual interface and state coupling, reducing underspecified compilation and coherent-but-unexercised mechanisms. Under the frozen matched protocol this predicts zero invalid arms, more candidate pair wins than losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo; only a non-promoting exact or decisively bounded score-rate ratio of at least 0.90 warrants development.
hypothesis.falsifier: Falsify formal promotion unless the frozen batch completes the required valid matched evidence with zero invalid arms, candidate wins strictly exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly exceeding incumbent-median Elo. Reject this counter family rather than develop it if the exact three-pair ratio or decisive two-pair bound is below 0.90. Mechanistically falsify it if the first call emits a complete UCI engine, a normalized anchor, a prose contract, or an anchor-relative edit program instead of one independently runnable component; if it creates or compares multiple components; if no component execution trace precedes integration; or if the final call ignores, replaces, or selects an alternative to the demonstrated capability.
hypothesis.behavioral_novelty: The loop can make one strength-bearing capability executable, observe its predicted and edge behavior, and repair its implementation before any full candidate engine exists. It then transports demonstrated code and traces rather than rewritten whole-engine semantics or instructions about code, allowing the final call to graft a behavior that has already run into one untouched anchor. The champion cannot execute strength-bearing work before its final whole engine, R16 has no independently observable pre-final artifact, and R17's intermediate program is descriptive rather than executable.

family_break.champion_family: Executable Semantic-Normal-Form Transduction: a representation-only role emits a complete canonical engine, after which a separate final role first implements and executes the strength-bearing change in that whole-engine substrate.
rejected_core_assumptions: A strength-bearing mechanism must be embedded in a complete engine before executable feedback about its implementation is useful.
The useful construction object crossing a specialist boundary must be either complete engine source or instructions for changing that source.
forbidden_champion_mechanisms: A behavior-preserving semantic-normal-form engine emitted as an intermediate artifact
A complete-engine handoff from a representation owner to a later strength transducer
A final strength owner that receives no already executed strength-bearing implementation
A provisional candidate engine followed by review, delta attribution, preservation, rollback, or selection
A declarative anchor-relative transformation program used as the sole inter-call construction carrier
A persistent single actor that privately owns diagnosis through final engine emission
Replicated components, engines, agents, samples, variants, or best-of-N selection
family_break.alternative_causal_principle: De-risk construction by making the smallest complete strength-bearing capability, rather than a whole engine or edit description, the first executable artifact. Demonstrate and repair one portable component against task-general interface fixtures, then graft exactly that behavior once into the original source authority and emit one engine.

difference_from_champion.information_flow: The champion passes an entire representation-only engine to a role that must invent the strength implementation. The candidate passes one runnable strength-bearing component, its explicit interface, and its execution trace while sending the untouched anchor separately to the sole engine producer.
difference_from_champion.error_detection: The champion can observe mechanism defects only after the strength change is coupled into the final whole engine. The candidate first exercises the component's predicted effect, determinism, state boundaries, edge cases, and bounded work behavior outside engine integration, so component faults are distinguished from adapter faults.
difference_from_champion.final_decision: The champion's final owner chooses and realizes the strength mechanism. In the candidate, the foundry commits by producing one working capability; the final owner may only embed that demonstrated behavior through a conforming adapter and decide when the resulting single engine satisfies general validity obligations.
difference_from_champion.failure_recovery: The champion repairs an unfinished whole-engine transformation after mechanism and integration failures are entangled. The candidate repairs the same isolated component before transfer, then repairs only the single graft's interface or coupling in the final call; it cannot switch mechanisms, compare candidates, or use preserve-versus-rollback arbitration.

family_break.non_derivative_probe: Give the champion, R17, and this candidate the same anchor plus a task-general capability whose core behavior can run over primitive state records. This family is present only if the first response contains source for exactly one runnable non-UCI component and a real deterministic execution trace showing the predicted behavior before any engine source is emitted, and the second call receives the byte-identical anchor plus that component and is the only engine producer. A complete normalized engine identifies the champion, a private one-call work lineage identifies R16, an ordered source-edit program without runnable capability code identifies R17, and a prose or probe-only artifact fails the candidate family.

strengths: Turns one causal idea into executable evidence before whole-engine coupling, exposing implementation and interface errors earlier than source-wide construction.
Preserves undocumented anchor behavior because the original supplied source remains authoritative until one bounded graft.
Gives the final producer concrete working code and traces while retaining freedom to adapt the interface without rediagnosing the mechanism.
Contains exactly one component and one final engine, with no replicated candidates, agents, samples, variants, ranking, or best-of-N selection.
risks: A component that succeeds on primitive fixtures may fail to capture timing, recursion, or shared-state interactions present only in the full engine.
The grafting adapter may distort the demonstrated behavior or require broader source changes than the component interface anticipated.
Task-general isolated correctness and bounded work evidence may still correlate weakly with playing strength.
Constructing the component may consume context that the final call needs for careful integration, and the committed capability may still be strategically weak.
hypothesis.dominant_assumption: The champion assumes that meaningful executable construction must remain at whole-engine granularity: first canonicalize a complete engine, then let the final owner create and test strength only inside another complete engine.
hypothesis.inversion: Make the sole strength-bearing mechanism executable before any candidate engine exists, carry that demonstrated component across the reasoning boundary, and defer only its one-time graft into the untouched anchor to the final engine-producing call.

structure.name: Isolated Capability Foundry and Single Graft
structure.information_flow: The task, one supplied anchor, aggregate metrics, bounded capsule, hypothesis, and loop contract enter a non-engine mechanism foundry. It emits exactly one independently runnable strength-bearing component with an explicit primitive interface and deterministic execution evidence, never a UCI engine or source-edit program. The byte-identical supplied anchor and that sole component artifact enter one final grafting producer, which embeds the demonstrated behavior once and emits exactly one complete engine.

calls.objective: Inspect exactly one supplied anchor and the bounded task evidence without modifying or reproducing the engine. Commit to exactly one highest-leverage task-general causal capability, then implement it as exactly one standalone executable Python component over an explicit primitive input/output and state interface. The component must contain real strength-bearing behavior, not a UCI loop, complete engine, patch, ordered anchor edits, prose contract, menu, or probe alone. Create one bounded deterministic synthetic fixture set covering the predicted effect, a null case, state-boundary cases, and work-safety; execute the same component, record observed traces, and repair that one component in place until its declared behavior, determinism, interface, and bounded-work obligations hold. Return one compact artifact containing the component source, interface, causal prediction, falsifier, execution commands and traces, and integration invariants. Do not create, sample, compare, rank, or select alternative components or engines; do not use benchmark positions, evaluator internals, benchmark-specific logic, or engine-hyperparameter tuning as the structural change.

Treat champion_engine as the untouched supplied source authority and isolated_mechanism_foundry as the sole authorized strength-bearing capability. Emit exactly one complete legal production engine by embedding the component's demonstrated semantics through one coherent interface into one working copy of the anchor. Preserve behavior outside the necessary dependency closure; adapt representation and coupling only as required to make the same component behavior native to the engine. Re-run the component's deterministic fixtures through the integrated interface plus bounded syntax, UCI, legal-move, state-integrity, perft where applicable, determinism, timing-safety, and focused consequence checks. If a check fails, repair only this same graft in place. Do not rediagnose or substitute another mechanism, emit or compare provisional engines, retain a standalone alternative, invoke a reviewer or selector, use preserve-versus-rollback arbitration, globally normalize or clean-room rewrite the engine, follow an anchor-relative edit program, tune engine hyperparameters as the structural hypothesis, or use benchmark-specific knowledge. Return exactly one complete engine as the sole engine artifact.
